crossRefs.note: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles…
but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,
but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

people.name: Damascus

translations.web: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.
translations.bsb: In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas secured the city of the Damascenes in order to arrest me.
translations.kjv: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept ➔ the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
